rules.statement: Every Clipper Network decision is negative (RULES_NOT_IN_FORCE) until Andre has approved a rule version.
rules.title: No decision without an Andre-approved rule version

sources.text: Whop: eighteen (18) years of age or older

rules.statement: Admission requires Verification and Integrity's latest age attestation for the clipper to be adult. A tick box never counts. There is no guardian path.
rules.title: Admission only with a V&I adult attestation

rules.statement: Admission requires Compliance's latest zbc_creator activation ruling for the clipper to be allowed, and a jurisdiction class of operate or conditional.
rules.title: Latest Compliance activation allowed

sources.text: Vyro: Limit one (1) Account per person/email address

rules.statement: Duplicate-identity check clear at V&I; one email and one payout identity per clipper; account sharing or renting forbidden.
rules.title: One identity per person

sources.text: compliance report creator agreement clause set

rules.statement: The clipper has accepted the Clipper Agreement version that Legal (37) names as current (clickwrap, versioned record, never the text).
rules.title: Current Clipper Agreement accepted

rules.statement: Finance (31) confirms a W-9 or W-8 is on file; Clipper Network stores the status only.
rules.title: Tax form on file at Finance

rules.statement: Admission needs at least one active V&I connection on an enabled platform.
rules.title: At least one active V&I connection

sources.text: 16 CFR 255.1(d): Provide guidance to their endorsers

rules.statement: The clipper has attested the disclosure training.
rules.title: Disclosure training attested

rules.statement: Recruiting outbound goes only to people with an opt-in record; no cold outbound to Canada; never targets minors; no income claims; every recruiting email passes Compliance's publish gate first.
rules.title: Recruiting only to opted-in people

rules.statement: No bulk DMs; SMS off; Reddit and X off.
rules.title: Channels

rules.statement: Tier from verified outcomes only: V&I certifications (certified or revised) and the strike mirror.
rules.title: Tier table

rules.statement: A tier changes campaign access and rate-card visibility only; never a certified count or a payout rule.
rules.title: Tier never touches counts or pay

rules.statement: Enrolment only when every §C.4 condition holds.
rules.title: Enrolment eligibility

sources.text: Whop: Maximum Payout per creator per video
Kiip caps limit exposure to view botting (secondary)

rules.statement: Caps per clipper (active enrolments by tier) and per campaign (max_clippers).
rules.title: Caps

rules.statement: Deliver only Creative's Andre-signed kit of the live rulebook version; never an edited copy.
rules.title: Signed kit of the live rulebook only

rules.statement: Every message comes from an Andre-approved template version; outside the recipient-local quiet window it waits; no time zone means in-app only.
rules.title: Approved templates; quiet hours

parameters.disclosure_text: This message comes from an automated system run by Z Best Clips. You can reach a person (Andre) at any time: reply HUMAN.

sources.text: Onboarding P1; Cal. B&P 17941 (wording by counsel, CN-CQ-08)

rules.statement: The first message and the admission decision disclose automation and offer a human.
rules.title: Automation disclosure

sources.text: analogue only: Cal. Lab. Code 1700.24 7-day fee-change notice

rules.statement: The rate card is Finance's document, rendered by reference only; a change is announced at least rate_notice_days ahead and applies to clips posted after its effective date.
rules.title: Rate card from Finance, with notice

sources.text: CR: one appeal per flagged Submission; aims to respond within 10 business days; ban may be appealed once

rules.statement: One appeal per flagged clip; answer within the SLA; an org-wide ban appealable once.
rules.title: Appeals

rules.statement: Discipline follows only V&I strikes whose evidence ids resolve at V&I, per the discipline table.
rules.title: Discipline only from V&I strikes

sources.text: CR: final decision is always made by a person

rules.statement: A ban takes effect only on Andre's approval.
rules.title: A ban needs Andre

rules.statement: Offboarding: access revoked, Finance open items flagged, export, deletion after the retention period; nothing Finance or an open dispute needs is deleted.
rules.title: Clean exit

rules.statement: Every rulebook version is announced to every active enrolment.
rules.title: Rulebook versions announced

rules.statement: An open counsel question (CN-CQ-*) blocks what it names until Andre approves a counsel memo.
rules.title: Counsel holds block what they name

rules.statement: No DOB, ID data, tax data, legal name, IP address or payment details are stored here.
rules.title: Minimum data

rules.statement: No quotas, required hours, exclusivity or posting schedules; the clipper chooses whether and when to post.
rules.title: No quotas

rules.statement: No promised earnings, views or results and no money value in any message.
rules.title: No guarantees, no money

rules.statement: Does recruiting clippers and placing them on brand campaigns make ZBC a talent agency, and are short-form clippers artists?

rules.title: AB 5 classification

rules.statement: May SAG-AFTRA members be admitted to campaigns, and does the 2025 Influencer Waiver apply to clipping?
rules.title: SAG-AFTRA members

rules.title: Reddit and X recruiting rules

templates.body: Hi {display_name}, we received your application {application_id} to the Z Best Clips network (18+ only). Your next steps are shown in your hub. {automation_disclosure}
Hi {display_name}, admission decision {admission_id}: {decision}. Rules applied: {rule_ids}. Items still open: {open_count}. {automation_disclosure}
Clipper Agreement {doc_id} version {doc_version} is now current. Accept it in your hub before your next campaign enrolment (rule {rule_ids}).

Finance published rate card {rate_card_doc_id} version {rate_card_version} (SHA-256 {rate_card_sha256}) for campaign {campaign_id}. Read it in your hub. It applies to clips posted on or after {effective_date} (rule {rule_ids}).

Finance changed the rate card for campaign {campaign_id} to {rate_card_doc_id} version {rate_card_version} (SHA-256 {rate_card_sha256}). The change takes effect on {effective_date} and applies only to clips posted after that date (rule {rule_ids}).

Campaign {campaign_id} now has rulebook version {rulebook_version}. Clips are judged by the version they were made under. The kit for the new version is in your hub when Creative has signed it (rule {rule_ids}).

Your kit {kit_id} for campaign {campaign_id} (rulebook version {rulebook_version}, SHA-256 {kit_sha256}) is in your hub. Please confirm you received the rulebook, the disclosure section and rate card version {rate_card_version} (rule {rule_ids}).
Clip {submission_id} was flagged under rule {rule_ids} (evidence {evidence_ids}). You may appeal once until {appeal_deadline}.
Clip {submission_id}: verification status {cert_status}, certified views {certified_views}. Questions about settlement go to Finance.
Verification and Integrity recorded a {strike_class} strike ({strike_id}) under rule {rule_ids}. Evidence: {evidence_ids}. Consequence: {consequence}. You may appeal once until {appeal_deadline}.
You are suspended ({suspension_kind}) until {until} under rule {rule_ids} (strike {strike_id}). You may appeal once until {appeal_deadline}.
Andre approved a permanent ban ({decision_id}) under rule {rule_ids}. Your access has ended and your exit has started. You may appeal the ban once until {appeal_deadline}.
We received your appeal {dispute_id}. A person will answer by {sla_date} (rule {rule_ids}).

Your exit {offboarding_id} has started and campaign access has ended. Connected accounts: {connections}. Exit status: {offboarding_status}. Contact details are deleted {retention_days} days after exit unless an open item still needs them (rule {rule_ids}).
Your data export {export_ref} (SHA-256 {export_sha256}) is ready in your hub.

Advertisement. Z Best Clips is looking for video clippers, 18+ only. You post from your own accounts and choose whether and when to post. All terms are explained in full before you join. Apply through the Z Best Clips hub. To stop these emails: {opt_out_link} {postal_address}
